book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: QꞌU KAM IBꞌAXABꞌSA IKꞌUCHAXU TIOXH TU U XHAN (Apocalipsis) U uꞌuj uvaꞌ Apocalipsis uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun

content: Ni toksal iqꞌii u Tiixh tu almikaꞌ
Tul kat bꞌaꞌnxi, as kat vabꞌi umaꞌl u mam tuul viꞌ tu almikaꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ tuul iviꞌ mamaꞌla tenam. As ech nikat tal ileꞌ:

content.text: ¡Qoksataj iqꞌii u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ!
Tan Aakeꞌ kat qꞌalpun oꞌ. As Aakeꞌ la qoksa iqꞌii, tan taꞌn Aakeꞌ uveꞌ at iyakꞌil.
As jik chit itxumbꞌal Aak tul nibꞌan Aak isuuchil unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil, tan tukꞌ chit jikla yol nibꞌankat Aak isuuchil.
Tan kat taqꞌlu veꞌt bꞌen Aak u yanaꞌsla ixojeꞌ tu kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ,
tan nik iyansa ixoj unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ.
As kat taqꞌlu veꞌt Aak ichꞌexel te u ixojeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat iyatzꞌ ixoj unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ, tiꞌk unqꞌa tuul viꞌeꞌ.
As ech kat tal ileꞌ unpajte:
¡Qoksataj iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ!
Tan nijeꞌ veꞌt visibꞌil u ixojeꞌ tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ, tiꞌk u mam tuul viꞌeꞌ tala.

content: As vinaj kajvaꞌl unqꞌa qꞌesla chaj aamaeꞌ tukꞌ kajvaꞌt unqꞌa islich aama, as kat kuꞌ veꞌt qaaloj vatz u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ xonleꞌl viꞌ u nimla xonlebꞌaleꞌ. As ech tal ileꞌ: —¡An chiteꞌ taꞌ! ¡Tan taꞌn axheꞌ ni toksal veꞌt aqꞌii!— tiꞌke.
As el chꞌuꞌl umaꞌt u tuul viꞌ tu vinimla xonlebꞌal u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ ech tal ileꞌ:

content.text: ¡Etoksataj iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ,
jankꞌal chit ex uvaꞌ ni niman Aak, as ex uvaꞌ at etijleꞌm tukꞌ ex uvaꞌ yeꞌl etijleꞌm ati!
As etoksataj iqꞌii Aak tiꞌ exoꞌvat Aak, tiꞌk u tuul viꞌeꞌ.

content: As vabꞌi veꞌt umaꞌt tuul viꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ tuul iviꞌ mamaꞌla tenam uvaꞌ ech ivuluneꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa nimla aꞌeꞌ. As ech ijinkabꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa qꞌankooeꞌ. As ech tal ileꞌ:

content.text: —¡Qoksataj veꞌt iqꞌii u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ!
Tan Aakeꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil. As kat okyu veꞌt Aak tiꞌ u tijleꞌmeꞌ.
¡As chiibꞌojtaj oꞌ! ¡As okoj u chiibꞌichileꞌ tu u qaanxelaleꞌ!
¡As qoksataj iqꞌii Aak!
Tan kat ilejlu veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ teqꞌot tibꞌ u Kaneeroꞌ tukꞌ u tixqeleꞌ.
As kat ibꞌanlu veꞌt u ixojeꞌ tucheꞌ tiꞌ teqꞌot tibꞌ tukꞌ vitzumeleꞌ.
As kat aqꞌaxyu veꞌt te u tixqeleꞌ tiꞌ ivejat tibꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj nuꞌkin oksaꞌmeꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌl chit ipolal. As vaꞌl chit ilitzꞌloꞌlaneꞌ,—

content: tiꞌk u tuul viꞌeꞌ.

As tal veꞌt u ángeleꞌ sve: —Tzꞌibꞌa u yolaꞌ: «¡Tan achvebꞌal chit unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat molol veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ u txꞌaꞌoꞌmeꞌ tul ni teqꞌo tibꞌ u Kaneeroꞌeꞌ tukꞌ u tixqeleꞌ!»— tiꞌke. As tal unpajte: —Aꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ alel taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ. As jikla yol chiteꞌ,— tiꞌk u ángeleꞌ tala.

As kuꞌ veꞌt in qaaloj vatz u ángel tiꞌ unnachat Tiixh svatz. As ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ sve: —Yeꞌ abꞌan echeꞌ u veeꞌ, tan in kuxh ikꞌam u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ axh tukꞌ unjoltu unqꞌa eetzꞌin aatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ ni niman unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat ul tal u Jesús sete. ¡Pet aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ la etoksa iqꞌii! Tan aꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Jesús, as aꞌeꞌ ni aqꞌon itxumbꞌal unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ,— tiꞌk u ángel.
Ni til u Xhun umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ atik jeꞌ tiꞌ umaꞌl u sajiꞌ kaay

As vila uvaꞌ jajlik veꞌt u almikaꞌeꞌ. As chee veꞌt umaꞌl u sajiꞌ kaay uvaꞌ atik jeꞌ umaꞌl u naj stiꞌ uvaꞌ jikla kꞌujlebꞌal kꞌuꞌl chit vibꞌiieꞌ, tan tu chit ijikil nibꞌan isuuchil unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil. As tu chit ijikil nibꞌan u chꞌaꞌoeꞌ unpajte.
As ech chit tilon u bꞌaqꞌ ivatzeꞌ echeꞌ taqꞌ xamal. As nimal chit unqꞌa koroona atik jeꞌ tiꞌ iviꞌ. As tzꞌibꞌamalik umaꞌl u bꞌii stiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil ootzin tetz. Pet Aak kuxh ootzin tetz.
As atik ok umaꞌl u toksaꞌm staꞌn uvaꞌ matik ijilpik kuꞌ xeꞌ u kajeꞌ. As vibꞌii u uxhchileꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ «kꞌuchul tetz u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ.»

As nimal chit unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ xekelik tiꞌ Aak uvaꞌ atik tu almikaꞌ. As ech tilon unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ echeꞌ sol, tan atik jeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa sajiꞌ kaayeꞌ. As atik ok unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla nuꞌkin oksaꞌmeꞌ staꞌn uvaꞌ vaꞌl chit ipolal.

As u najeꞌ uvaꞌ atik jeꞌ tiꞌ u sajiꞌ kaayeꞌ, as el chꞌuꞌl umaꞌl u jutzꞌ viꞌ chꞌichꞌ titziꞌ uvaꞌ xiꞌleꞌl chit tee, tan tukꞌ u chꞌichꞌeꞌ nikꞌaxbꞌisakat veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil. As la kꞌaxbꞌisal unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil taꞌn u najeꞌ tukꞌ umaꞌl u bꞌaara uvaꞌ chꞌichꞌ chittuꞌ. As echeꞌ ni tulbꞌel u uuvaeꞌ tul uvaꞌ nipochꞌil u taꞌleꞌ, as echat la tulbꞌe unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil tiꞌ ikꞌaxbꞌisaleꞌ tukꞌ vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌl u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil.
As tzꞌibꞌamal veꞌt ibꞌii u najeꞌ tiꞌ u toksaꞌmeꞌ uveꞌ txala ikux. As ech vibꞌii ileꞌ:

content.text: Ineꞌ in Ijlenaal tiꞌ unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ skajayil.
As ineꞌ in Bꞌooqꞌol tiꞌ unqꞌa bꞌooqꞌoleꞌ skajayil.

content: As vil umaꞌt u ángel uvaꞌ txaklik viꞌ u qꞌiieꞌ. As sikꞌin veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ imolat unqꞌa txooeꞌ uvaꞌ nixichꞌan tu almikaꞌ. As ech tal ileꞌ: —¡Siꞌunaj! Emoltaj etibꞌ tiꞌ u nimla txꞌaꞌoꞌmeꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌanel tuch taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ.

As la echiꞌ veꞌt vichibꞌil unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa ichibꞌil iqꞌesal unqꞌa soleꞌ, tukꞌ vichibꞌil unqꞌa soleꞌ uveꞌ atik jeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa kaayeꞌ, tukꞌ vichibꞌil unqꞌa kaayeꞌ, tukꞌ vichibꞌil unqꞌa najeꞌ uvaꞌ at tijleꞌm, as tukꞌ vichibꞌil unjoltu unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, kꞌuxh kꞌam as kꞌuxh jit kꞌam, as kꞌuxh at tijleꞌm as kꞌuxh yeꞌl tijleꞌm ati,— tiꞌk u ángel tal te unqꞌa txooeꞌ.

As kat vil veꞌt u txooeꞌ uvaꞌ kat jeꞌ chꞌuꞌl xeꞌ u mar tukꞌ unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ skajayil vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa isoleꞌ. As kat imol tibꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ ibꞌanat chꞌaꞌo tiꞌ u najeꞌ uvaꞌ atik jeꞌ tiꞌ u sajiꞌ kaayeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa isoleꞌ.

As txeypu veꞌt u txooeꞌ uvaꞌ jeꞌ chꞌuꞌl xeꞌ u mar tukꞌ u chulin yolla txooeꞌ uvaꞌ jeꞌ chꞌuꞌl tu txꞌavaꞌ, uvaꞌ maꞌtik ikꞌuchat veꞌt txoo uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chit unqꞌa kꞌuchbꞌal tetz u tijleꞌm u txooeꞌ uvaꞌ ibꞌana. As maꞌtik imaxtibꞌet txoo unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ atik veꞌt ok u texhlal umaꞌt u txooeꞌ stiꞌ. As maꞌtik iqaaebꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ vatz vivatzibꞌal u txooeꞌ. As sutil veꞌt bꞌen txoo skaabꞌil tu u veeꞌ echeꞌ naabꞌ uvaꞌ ni toypukat u nimla xamaleꞌ tukꞌ azufre.

As u najeꞌ uvaꞌ atik jeꞌ tiꞌ u sajiꞌ kaayeꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ kat yatzꞌon veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ taꞌn u jutzꞌ viꞌ chꞌichꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nik tel chꞌuꞌl titziꞌ. As kat mox noo veꞌt unqꞌa txooeꞌ skajayil uvaꞌ nixichꞌan tu almikaꞌ tiꞌ ichiꞌat vichibꞌil unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ.
